main_measure.name: OLS slope of drift-adjusted 3-day return on abs forecast, over the cases
main_measure.threshold: slope t <= -2 confirms (with supporting check and >=30 cases on >=30 days); t >= +2 rejects

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move in the short direction > 0

decided_by: The slope's t lies between -2 and +2.
reading: Up day recomputed from closes and the falling-agitated profile read from the recorded regime (the detector's components are not recorded); a case is the first short bet (forecast rising in size by >= 2 points from its lowest level on the short side since the last bet) in each 3-bar grid cell of each window, and the slope's t is the ordinary OLS t pooled over all coins.

effect_check.why: t in the idea's direction +1.182 (not below 1), 562 cases (30 needed)
